flagged.reason: The video incorrectly attributes the 'unripe fruit' metaphor to Paris rather than Capulet, and states that Juliet takes four lines of the shared sonnet instead of six.

mark_affecting.quote: when the nobleman Paris views Juliet as a green or unripe fruit to be purchased through her father, Lord Capulet.
Juliet confidently takes four of those fourteen lines, sparring with him word for word.
